# spo_site_design (Data Source)

Look up an existing SiteDesign object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The site design description.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether the design applies to all new sites of the web template.
- `preview_image_alt_text` (String) Preview image alt text.
- `preview_image_url` (String) Preview image URL.
- `site_scripts` (Set of String) Ordered site-script GUIDs the design runs.
- `title` (String) The site design display name.
- `web_template` (String) Site template the design applies to: 64 (team site), 68 (communication site), 1 (group).
